question: ‘Ong’ and ‘Tel’ are tributaries of the river ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Tel, Jonk, Seonath are the major tributary of Mahanadi.
 
• The Mahanadi is a major river in East Central India.
 
• The Mahanadi rises in the highlands of Chhattisgarh.
 
• It flows through Odisha to reach the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The length of the river is about 860 km.
 
• Its drainage basin is shared by Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Odisha.
 
• Its main tributaries are the Seonath, the Jonk, the Hasdeo, the Mand, the ib, the Ong, and the Tel.
